answer: Nectar-link ledger. Every agent action emits a signed digest committed to a rolling Merkle chain; at each epoch boundary, a new key is derived only if prior-epoch digests verify against the same behavioural fingerprint (action-type distribution, timing cadence, counterparty graph). New keys start hollow—zero trust weight—and earn weight only through verified continuity. Sybils must fake sustained, correlated histories across many epochs, and any break resets accumulated standing to crystal-zero, forcing costly re-acquisition of reputation and routing priority.
